#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, subprocess, sys, time, os

CTX = {
    "directory": {"sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"],
                  "sip:desk@sales.test": ["tel:+12025550122"]},
    "accounts": {"session-k": {"primary": "sip:ember@studio.test", "allow": ["sip:desk@sales.test"]}},
    "gateways": {"edge": {"local_domains": ["studio.test", "sales.test"], "peers": {}},
                 "inside": {"local_domains": [], "peers": {"edge": ["studio.test", "sales.test"]}}},
}
LOCAL = {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}
body = "y" * 1600
raw = ("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\n"
       "From: \"A, visitor\" <SIP:%65mber@STUDIO.TEST.>;tag=q7\r\n"
       "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\nCall-ID: sample-73\r\nCSeq: 0009 MESSAGE\r\n"
       "Content-Type: text/plain\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\n\r\n%s" % (len(body), body))
print("raw len", len(raw))
jobs = [{"gateway": "edge", "ingress": LOCAL, "trusted_out": True, "raw": raw} for _ in range(2000)]
batch = dict(CTX); batch["jobs"] = jobs
data = json.dumps(batch).encode()
print("input size", len(data))
t = time.time()
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"], input=data, capture_output=True)
dt = time.time() - t
print("exit", proc.returncode, "time %.2fs" % dt, "out", len(proc.stdout))
res = json.loads(proc.stdout)["results"]
print(len(res), res[0]["status"], len(res[0].get("wire", "")))

# source reuse chain: 2048 jobs all referencing one big accepted wire
jobs = [{"gateway": "edge", "ingress": LOCAL, "trusted_out": True, "raw": raw}]
for i in range(1, 2048):
    jobs.append({"gateway": "edge", "ingress": LOCAL, "trusted_out": True, "source": 0})
batch = dict(CTX); batch["jobs"] = jobs
t = time.time()
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"], input=json.dumps(batch).encode(), capture_output=True)
print("reuse exit", proc.returncode, "time %.2fs" % (time.time() - t))
res = json.loads(proc.stdout)["results"]
print(sum(1 for r in res if r["status"] == "accept"))

# stress: many headers + long values
hs = "".join("X-Pad-%04d: %s\r\n" % (i, "v" * 60) for i in range(120))
raw2 = ("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\n" + hs +
        "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7\r\nTo: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\n"
        "Call-ID: c\r\nCSeq: 9 MESSAGE\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\n\r\n%s" % (len(body), body))
jobs = [{"gateway": "edge", "ingress": LOCAL, "trusted_out": True, "raw": raw2} for _ in range(2000)]
batch = dict(CTX); batch["jobs"] = jobs
t = time.time()
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"], input=json.dumps(batch).encode(), capture_output=True)
print("headers exit", proc.returncode, "time %.2fs" % (time.time() - t))
PYEOF
